findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: platform_catalog, report_gap, gap_check, gap_reply, checkout_intent, booking_intent, concierge_walk · Private data: platform_catalog, market_walk, market_search, report_gap, concierge_document, concierge_ask, shipping_options, checkout_intent, booking_intent · Public sink: report_gap, gap_check, gap_reply, checkout_intent, booking_intent, concierge_walk · Destructive: market_walk, report_gap, gap_check, concierge_ask.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: platform_catalog, report_gap, gap_check, gap_reply, checkout_intent, booking_intent, concierge_walk · Private data: platform_catalog, market_walk, market_search, report_gap, concierge_document, concierge_ask, shipping_options, checkout_intent, booking_intent · Public sink: report_gap, gap_check, gap_reply, checkout_intent, booking_intent, concierge_walk · Destructive: market_walk, report_gap, gap_check, concierge_ask

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "market_walk" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
